monitoring.countHint: Counted once per instance selection; failover re-selection adds extra counts.
monitoring.emptyDescription: No routing event has been collected yet; once sampling is on, events stream in over WebSocket.
monitoring.emptySearchDescription: No event matches the current service type filter. Clear the filter or wait for new pushes.

confirmations.clearHistoryMessage: Clear all routing monitoring history? This cannot be undone.

strategyConfig.pageDesc: The global default is read-only; per-service strategies are edited inline and saved from the action bar at the bottom.
strategyConfig.globalReadonlyHint: The global default strategy comes from configuration (jairouter.load-balance); the console exposes no write endpoint, so change the configuration file and restart.
strategyConfig.configureHint: Edit per-service strategies inline; saving replaces each service as a whole and rebuilds its load balancer immediately
strategyConfig.saveHint: Each row is replaced as a whole (PUT /loadbalancer/config/{serviceType}); omitted hash algorithm and virtual nodes fall back to md5 / 150, so all fields are sent explicitly.

strategyDescriptions.random: Selects instances by weight at random, ideal for stateless request scenarios
strategyDescriptions.roundRobin: Selects instances by weight in rotation, suitable for evenly distributed load
strategyDescriptions.leastConnections: Selects the instance with the fewest active connections, ideal for long-lived connections
strategyDescriptions.ipHash: Selects an instance by hashing the client IP, suitable for session-affinity scenarios
strategyDescriptions.consistentHash: Selects an instance through a consistent hash ring, suitable for distributed caching
strategyDescriptions.latency: Dynamically selects the lowest-latency instance using EWMA-based latency estimates, ideal when backend latency varies significantly

messages.configUpdated: Load balancing config of service {serviceType} updated
